deployments_detail.use: AI-native land acquisition and development analysis platform (Prophetic). Translates zoning rules, environmental data and parcel records into instant, verifiable site potential; automates land discovery/entitlement feasibility. Selected for an organization-wide, multi-year deployment across D.R. Horton, Forestar and DHI engineering, rolling out division by division across 30+ states. [Prophetic (Prophetic Technologies / Prophetic Software) - proprietary modules ZoneAI, SiteAI, DevMap, DealDesk, SearchAI]
deployments_detail.value: Org-wide across 30+ states; land analysis reduced from ~2-3 hours (weeks of manual work) to ~6 minutes; Prophetic users regularly process ~5,700 parcels/month vs a few hundred manually

deployments_detail.use: AI-powered construction site intelligence via drone mapping. Combines drone scans, cloud software and AI to verify/optimize earthwork (cut/fill and volumetric analysis), suggest grading strategies and haul roads, monitor construction progress, and reduce rework across land acquisition, development and vertical construction phases. Rolled out nationwide. [TraceAir]

Voice-AI smart home assistant embedded in every new home. D.R. Horton's 'Home is Connected' smart home system integrates Amazon Alexa for hands-free, voice-first control of home automation (thermostat, locks, doorbell, switches), included as standard in each new home across its brands (Emerald, Express, Freedom). [Amazon Alexa (voice assistant); Qolsys hub, Alarm.com, Resideo/Honeywell, Kwikset, Eaton, SkyBell]

Autonomous robotic construction 3D-printing. D.R. Horton made a strategic investment in Apis Cor, whose autonomous robotic systems ('Frank') 3D-print concrete building structures on the job site, and planned to work together on a multi-unit construction project in South Florida to address labor shortages and productivity. [Apis Cor (autonomous robotic 3D-printing systems)]
Prophetic AI platform for zoning analysis + land acquisition at national scale (Nov 2025)

Agentic AI mortgage origination platform deployed by DHI Mortgage (D.R. Horton's mortgage subsidiary). Autonomous AI agents (incl. borrower/LO support agent 'SOLO') handle document review, data entry, verification and underwriting-adjacent tasks to shorten underwriting timelines for D.R. Horton homebuyers. D.R. Horton is both investor (participated in Tidalwave's $22M Series A) and customer. [Tidalwave (agentic AI); integrations with Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, Plaid, Argyle, Truv]
deployments_detail.value: $22M Series A (D.R. Horton participated); platform reportedly cuts closing time from ~45 days to under 2 weeks
